title: A demo's share link counts who opens it, never a bot or the seller, and the seller marks the outreach state
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable PostgreSQL server, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: GET /api/website-opportunities/:id/outreach of a QA-passed demo answers url = <origin>/d/<32-character token> and siteUrl = the demo address; the message carries the share link, not the demo address; a second read answers the same link.
GET /d/<token> answers 302 to the demo address with Cache-Control no-store and Referrer-Policy no-referrer and sets no cookie; /d/<token>/menu?lang=vi answers 302 to <demo>/menu?lang=vi.

Opens by a phone, a desktop and another signed-in person are counted (3 rows); HEAD, facebookexternalhit, WhatsApp preview, curl, no User-Agent, Sec-Purpose prefetch and the seller's own session are sent on but not counted.
wo_demo_open has exactly the columns id, link_id, opened_at, path, device; demo.opens on the detail, the list row and /ops/wo reads total 3, phone 1, desktop 2.

An unknown or malformed token answers 404, a stopped link 404 (DELETE /api/website-opportunities/:id/demo/link, owner only), a deleted demo 410; past 60 counted opens an hour a person is still sent on, uncounted.

PUT /api/website-opportunities/:id/outreach/state: 401 signed out, 404 for another account, 403 from a foreign Origin or a same-site fetch, 400 INVALID_OUTREACH_STATE for an unknown state; sent keeps its first time, won and lost clear each other, none clears every mark.

tests: the device class and what counts as a person are read from the request alone
the outreach hands out a share link that sends people to the demo and counts them, never the seller or a bot
an unknown, malformed or stopped link answers 404, a deleted demo 410, and none of them counts
past the hourly cap of one link a person is still sent on, uncounted
a demo not ready for outreach gets no link, and reads no opens
the outreach state door marks sent, replied, won or lost for the owner only, with the time of each
